## Settings YAML

```yaml
format:
  revealjs:
    pointer:
      trail: true
revealjs-plugins:
  - pointer
```

- Toggle Pointer: Press `q` to toggle pointer mode
- Trail Enabled: Move the pointer quickly to see the trail taper over time

## Cursor Smoke Test

Toggle pointer mode with `q`, then move across each interactive element

::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="50%"}

- [External link target](https://quarto.org/)
- Inline code span: `hover check`
- Button: <button type="button">Test Button</button>
- Input: <input type="text" placeholder="Test input" value="editable field" />

:::
::: {.column width="50%"}

**Expected Behavior**

- System cursor should stay hidden over all elements during pointer mode
- Custom pointer dot should remain visible and aligned
- When pointer mode is off, normal cursor behavior should return
